activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock breaks above a significant 6-month resistance at ₹500 with high volume. During the subsequent pullback to ₹500, what technical role does the ₹500 level now play, and why?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock breaks above a significant 6-month resistance at ₹500 with high volume. During the subsequent pullback to ₹500, what technical role does the ₹500 level now play, and why?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: It becomes new SUPPORT (Role Reversal). Trapped shorts rush to buy back at breakeven (₹500), while sidelined traders who missed the original breakout eagerly buy the first retest, creating a massive wave of fresh demand.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
